summary: As a Finance Operations Manager responsible for WhatsApp billing, I deal with mismatched invoices and manual reconciliation every month. It's annoying and time-consuming, but not a crisis. I'd consider a tool if it were cheap, easy to set up, and clearly saved me hours. But honestly, I'm not convinced I'd pay much—spreadsheets work, and I can ask a developer to script something. The pain is real but the willingness to pay is low.
strongest_points: If the tool automates the entire reconciliation process and cuts my monthly effort from 4 hours to 15 minutes, I'd be interested—especially if it costs under $50/month.
Direct integration with Meta's billing API and my BSP (e.g., Twilio) would eliminate manual exports and reduce errors—that's a strong pull.
Pre-built dispute reports that I can submit to Meta or my BSP would save me from writing support tickets and chasing refunds.
weaknesses: My willingness to pay is low (score 1/5). I'm not sure the ROI justifies a new SaaS subscription when spreadsheets and free scripts exist.
Switching friction: I already have a working (though painful) spreadsheet process. Adopting a new tool means training, data migration, and trusting it not to introduce errors.
Trust blockers: I'd be skeptical about data security (handling billing data) and whether the reconciliation logic is accurate enough to catch all discrepancies.
